nodes.name: Sample GraphRAG Basics
nodes.description: A public sample source about building a local GraphRAG workspace.

nodes.name: GraphRAG
nodes.description: A retrieval approach that combines a knowledge graph with retrieved text context.

nodes.name: Knowledge Graph
nodes.description: A graph of entities and relationships extracted from knowledge sources.

nodes.name: Semantic Search
nodes.description: Embedding-based search that retrieves related text by meaning.

nodes.name: Entity Extraction
nodes.description: The process of identifying important entities from source material.

nodes.name: Relationship Extraction
nodes.description: The process of converting source evidence into graph edges.

nodes.name: Retrieval Quality
nodes.description: A criterion for judging whether retrieved context is useful and grounded.

nodes.name: Evaluation Plan
nodes.description: A repeatable plan for testing graph and retrieval quality.

edges.evidence: The sample introduces entities and relationships as the graph layer.
The sample explains that embeddings can retrieve related notes even when wording differs.
Semantic search can improve retrieval when exact keywords do not match.
Entity extraction creates the graph nodes used by GraphRAG.
Relationship extraction creates the graph edges used by GraphRAG.
Evaluation makes retrieval quality measurable and easier to improve.
